summary: Frontend-only regression retest completed on PUBLIC preview URL for ConnectGBB membership flow. Login form data-testid fixes are verified and public host allowlist blocker appears resolved, but membership-aware route behavior remains unstable under repeated Supabase 404/429 failures.

ui_bugs.issue: Observed inconsistent locked state across membership-protected routes during a single authenticated session (messages/connections locked while training unlocked in same run).

integration_issues.issue: Frequent Supabase request failures (404 for community_memberships + ensure_community_membership, plus repeated 429 rate-limit responses) cause unstable/flickering effective access state across pages.

issues: No mixed loading+locked simultaneous rendering observed in this run, but membership loading can remain visible without reaching stable summary/locked panel when upstream calls fail repeatedly.

action_items: Stabilize useCommunityMembership requests (dedupe/retry/backoff/circuit-breaker) to avoid repeated 404/429 storms.
Ensure one deterministic fallback source for access checks (auth roles vs fetched roles) so lock state is consistent across all ConnectGBB pages in one session.
Keep PUBLIC preview healthy under automation load; current runs intermittently fail even reaching login inputs after 429 bursts.
critical_code_review_comments: LoginForm testability requirement is fixed: login-form-email-input, login-form-password-input, and login-form-submit-button exist.
PUBLIC endpoint host-allowlist blocker from iteration_4 is not reproduced; app is reachable and login flow works.
Current membership gating relies on failing table/RPC paths (404) and then fallback, which appears non-deterministic under network/rate-limit stress.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL is now accessible and login test IDs are present. Main residual blocker is unstable membership-aware gating caused by repeated Supabase 404/429 failures during page transitions. Re-test after membership lookup/fallback stabilization.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: login as coach_test_1780504587@example.com on public preview, navigate rapidly across /connectgbb, /connectgbb/feed, /connectgbb/messages, /connectgbb/connections, /connectgbb/training. Observed many Supabase 404 (community_memberships and ensure_community_membership RPC) and later 429s; route lock state diverges across pages in same session. Likely root cause: repeated membership fetch attempts per page/hook invocation + fallback role resolution inconsistency under failed/aborted requests.
